title: Capacity overflow panic with huge negative --line-range on macOS
body:
<!--

Hey there, thank you for reporting a bug!

Please note that the following bugs have already been reported:

* dpkg: error processing archive /some/path/some-program.deb (--unpack):
  trying to overwrite '/usr/.crates2.json'

  See https://github.com/sharkdp/bat/issues/938

-->

1. Install bat 0.26.1 via Homebrew on macOS.
2. Run:
   printf 'line1\nline2\nline3\n' | bat --line-range ':-999999999999999999'

**What happens?**

bat panics with a `capacity overflow` error and exits instead of displaying the input.

The terminal output includes:

thread 'main' panicked
capacity overflow


This appears related to the existing issue #3845, but I reproduced the panic independently on macOS 27.0.1 using the Homebrew build of bat 0.26.1.

Related issue: https://github.com/sharkdp/bat/issues/3845

**What did you expect to happen instead?**

bat should handle the large negative line range without panicking and should exit gracefully, ideally displaying the available input lines or reporting that the requested range is invalid.



**How did you install `bat`?**

Homebrew
